title: Maria Rotilu (GP, OpenseedVC) — 'Incorruptible is a must read for every intentional builder of our time'
summary: Maria Rotilu — General Partner at OpenseedVC ('First investor in exceptional operators') — was the host of the Sept 9 Startup Leap Day Zero conversation with Eric. Publishes her recap (44 likes) as an unequivocal endorsement: she read Incorruptible before its release as prep, and expects posterity to judge it kindly.
blockquote:
Eric wrote #TheLeanStartup, gave us language, tools, and mental models for building lean startups i suspect his new book, #Incorruptible will do the same for founders who want to create ambitious startups that outlive them for good.

I was glad to read the book before its release as part of prep for our conversation with Eric on The Startup Leap, and i believe posterity will judge this book kindly.

I really enjoyed speaking with Eric Ries, connecting with a wide range of intentional builders on day zero, and chatting through this book. Listening to the questions, hearing Eric's answers.

Incorruptible is a must read for every intentional builder of our time.
